Rice is then spread across the two existing serving plates, not packed into the capacity-unspecified filling bowl. Filling cooks as one batch in that same emptied saucepan:120g or240g raw egg, or180g or360g raw ground beef, with only reserved oil and seasoning. recipe.concept: A familiar honey mustard egg and rice meal for two, using its actual listed ingredients and one defined cooking route. Authored draft, not taste-tested.
recipe.serve_and_store: Divide the finished meal evenly between two people. Refrigerate perishable leftovers in shallow covered containers at 40 F (4 C) or colder within 2 hours, or 1 hour above 90 F (32 C). Reheat leftovers to 165 F (74 C). No recipe-specific storage life or physical cooking has been tested.

steps.instruction: Put only the reserved dry rice and cooking water shown below in the lidded saucepan. Bring to a simmer, cover and reduce to low. Cook until rice is tender and water absorbed. If water runs out while rice is still hard, turn off heat: this exact route has failed; do not add unreserved water or keep heating a dry pan. Once tender, turn the burner off; leave the covered saucepan on it and rest5minutes. With the spatula, spread all cooked rice across the existing clean serving plates, using both for room. Keep plates separate from raw-food handling. Leave the emptied saucepan on this sole burner for the filling. No rice is put in the capacity-unspecified filling bowl, and no hot pan is parked on a new trivet or counter.

Beat the allocated egg, garlic and salt in the raw-egg bowl. Warm only the allocated oil in the emptied saucepan on low heat; no nonstick surface is assumed. Add all reserved egg and gently fold until firm, no liquid egg remains and the center reaches160F(71C). Keep every cooked piece and measured oil in the pan. If the amount cannot be stirred, recovered or probed safely, this route is unavailable; do not add water, oil or extra egg. Keep raw utensils away from plated rice.

Turn the burner off and let bubbling stop. Fold all allocated Dijon mustard and honey into the cooked filling. Recover all filling, measured juices, oil and sauce onto the reserved rice. Serve all food on the plates promptly to the assigned person; two plates do not mean two people's food or leftovers. The brief rice wait is not a validated hot hold. Follow original safe cold-storage time limits if interrupted; reheating does not rescue improperly held rice.

steps.instruction: Use only the reserved bread amount shown below. Before handling raw egg, put bread flat in the clean, cool skillet, in fitting batches without overlap. Turn heat to low or medium-low. Toast dry; turn with the spatula when the underside is lightly golden and crisp. Toast the second side to the same cue. Watch continuously; reduce or turn off heat if browning too fast or smoking. Move each batch to clean serving plates. Add no oil, butter or toppings, and do not leave the empty nonstick pan heating between batches. Follow the pan's care instructions; if dry-food cooking is prohibited, this route is unavailable.

Turn off the burner. Use the spatula to clear loose bread crumbs onto the toast plates; let the pan cool enough that the measured oil will not smoke. Add only the oil allocated below, then return to low heat. Keep toast and clean plates separate from raw-egg utensils.

Whisk the allocated egg and salt in the raw-egg bowl. Cook in the oiled skillet on low to medium-low, folding gently until firm with no liquid egg and160F(71C) in the center. Fold in all allocated cheese near the end. Turn off heat. Serve all reserved toast, cooked egg, cheese and measured pan oil to the assigned person, using both existing serving plates if needed. Do not cook extra food or split the assignment into an unreserved batch.
